events.name: Green Bay Packers at Chicago Bears

headlines.description: The Monsters of the Midway showed up for the NFL's season opener. They were wearing gold, green and white.
headlines.shortLinkText: Packers D, Aaron Rodgers beat Bears 10-3 in opener

headlines.description: Maybe Marcus Mariota and the Titans deserved all the hype.
headlines.shortLinkText: Mariota, Titans sack Mayfield, hyped Browns 43-13 in opener

headlines.description: Nine minutes into the season, Lamar Jackson had fans booing his hometown team.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jackson's 5 TD passes help Ravens drub Dolphins 59-10

headlines.description: Anthony Harris highlighted a thorough thrashing by Minnesota's defense with two interceptions of Matt Ryan and a fumble recovery, Dalvin Cook carried a revived running attack, and the Vikings started the season with a 28-12 victory over the Atlanta...
headlines.shortLinkText: Vikings trample Falcons 28-12 behind fierce defense, Cook

events.name: Buffalo Bills at New York Jets

headlines.description: Josh Allen threw a 38-yard touchdown pass to John Brown with 3 minutes left, and the Buffalo Bills rallied from a 16-point second-half deficit to stun the New York Jets 17-16 in the season opener Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Allen, Bills overcome 16-point deficit, stun Jets 17-16

headlines.description: Carson Wentz threw a pair of deep touchdown passes to DeSean Jackson, and the Philadelphia Eagles overcame a 17-point deficit to beat the Washington Redskins 32-27 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jackson shines in Philly return, Eagles beat Redskins 32-27

events.name: Los Angeles Rams at Carolina Panthers

headlines.description: Jared Goff threw for 186 yards and a touchdown, Malcolm Brown ran for a pair of scores, and the defending NFC champion Los Angeles Rams spoiled Cam Newton's return with a 30-27 win over the Carolina Panthers on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Goff, Gurley lead Rams to 30-27 win over Panthers

events.name: Kansas City Chiefs at Jacksonville Jaguars

headlines.description: Despite losing star receiver Tyreek Hill early, Patrick Mahomes threw for 378 yards and three touchdowns while leading the Kansas City Chiefs to a testy and tactful 40-26 victory over the injury-riddled Jacksonville Jaguars on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Chiefs lose Hill, handle Jags 40-26 behind Mahomes, Watkins

events.name: Indianapolis Colts at Los Angeles Chargers

headlines.description: - Austin Ekeler scored three touchdowns, including the winner on a 7-yard run with 5:01 remaining in overtime, to give the Los Angeles Chargers a 30-24 victory over the Indianapolis Colts on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ekeler scores 3 TDs in Chargers 30-24 OT win over Colts

headlines.description: Russell Wilson hit Tyler Lockett for a 44-yard touchdown on the first play of the fourth quarter, and the Seattle Seahawks withstood a career day from Andy Dalton to beat the Cincinnati Bengals 21-20 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Close call: Seahawks hold off Dalton, Bengals for 21-20 win

events.name: New York Giants at Dallas Cowboys

headlines.description: Ezekiel Elliott's workload in the opener didn't matter much after the Dallas Cowboys running back missed the entire preseason in a holdout.
headlines.shortLinkText: Prescott lightens Elliott's load as Cowboys top Giants 35-17

headlines.description: After all that drama, Kyler Murray's debut ended in a tie that almost seemed like a win.
headlines.shortLinkText: Murray, Cardinals settle for 27-27 tie vs. Lions

events.name: San Francisco 49ers at Tampa Bay Buccaneers

headlines.description: Richard Sherman and Ahkello Witherspoon returned two of a retooled San Francisco defense's three interceptions of Jameis Winston for touchdowns and Robbie Gould kicked three field goals in the 49ers's 31-17 victory over Tampa Bay on Sunday.

events.name: Pittsburgh Steelers at New England Patriots

headlines.description: The New England Patriots trolled the Pittsburgh Steelers on Saturday and then blew them out Sunday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Brady starts his 20th season by beating Steelers 33-3

events.name: Houston Texans at New Orleans Saints

headlines.description: Wil Lutz made a 58-yard field goal as time expired to lift the New Orleans Saints to a 30-28 victory over the Houston Texans on Monday night in game that had three scoring plays in the final minute.
headlines.shortLinkText: Lutz's 58-yard field goal lifts Saints over Texans, 30-28

headlines.description: Derek Carr threw a touchdown pass on the opening drive of the season, rookie Josh Jacobs ran for two scores and the Oakland Raiders responded to a tumultuous week surrounding former receiver Antonio Brown by beating the Denver Broncos 24-16 on Monday...
headlines.shortLinkText: Raiders beat Broncos 24-16 in 1st game after Brown's release
